name: Sheraton Addis
positioning: Sheraton Addis, a Luxury Collection Hotel: a hilltop hotel overlooking Addis Ababa, opposite the National Palace, with heated outdoor pools, gardens and private villas
best_for: Diplomatic and business travelers who want a central Addis Ababa base near the UN Economic Commission for Africa
Families who want heated pools and a complimentary kids club

facts.text: The hotel is set 7,800 feet above sea level.
Designed by architect Kosek Ivo, the complex combines Ethiopian artistic culture with neo-classical style.
It was the first African hotel to join The Luxury Collection.
Guests have complimentary access to the heated outdoor pools, sauna and jacuzzi.
The three-floor VIP Private Villas have five bedrooms.
The hotel offers private butler service, fresh flowers and VIP amenities.
Guests in Executive rooms and suites have access to the Executive Lounge.
The Simba Kids Club offers supervised activities for toddlers to pre-teens.
Stanley's Bar has warm wood paneling and pictures of Ethiopia's past.
Shaheen serves Tandoori specialties and Northern Indian dishes from an open kitchen.
The UN Economic Commission for Africa is a five-minute drive from the hotel.
Conde Nast Traveler calls it the go-to hotel for visiting dignitaries and NGO heads.

highlights.text: Secluded three-story villas have their own outdoor pools.
The main pool has soft underwater music and is illuminated at night.
The hotel sits on a hilltop overlooking Addis Ababa, opposite the National Palace.
Nechisar Fitness Center is an outdoor setting overlooking the hotel's flower gardens, with an open-air workout area and a 600-meter jogging track.
Aqva Club, the hotel spa, includes outdoor swimming pools, sauna, massage and a jacuzzi.

considerations.text: There is no lifeguard on duty at the pools.
Massages at Aqva Club require advance reservation.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is primarily business-focused.
